title: Cursed Overlay (Crystal PVP)
description: A CURSED Crystal PvP resource pack that replaces Minecraft textures with dark and corrupted designs, adding a unique style to weapons, items, blocks, and PvP elements for a more intense combat experience.
body:
Cursed Crystal PvP Texture Pack

A long time ago, something was left behind...

This resource pack adds a cursed and corrupted style to Minecraft Crystal PvP. It changes weapons, items, blocks, and important PvP textures into darker and stranger versions to create a unique atmosphere during fights.

Made for Crystal PvP players, anarchy servers, and anyone who wants their Minecraft world to feel a little more unsettling.

Features
Custom cursed textures for PvP gameplay
Dark and corrupted visual style
Changes important combat items and blocks
Lightweight and easy to use
Designed for Crystal PvP
Changed Textures
Weapons & Items
Copper Axe
Copper Sword
Stick
Ender Pearl
Ender Eye
Golden Apple
Golden Carrot
Saddle
PvP Blocks & Explosives
Obsidian
Respawn Anchor
TNT
Environment Blocks
Dirt
Dirt Path (Top)
Dirt Path (Side)
Glowstone
Warped Wart Block

The pack replaces normal Minecraft textures with a cursed theme, giving every fight a different feeling while keeping the classic Minecraft style recognizable.

The curse spreads through every block, item, and battle.
